title: G03: UX-and-service-design gate contract (journeys / service-blueprint / accessibility / user-validation)
objective: Enforce Gate 03, declared in lifecycle.json but unbacked: give its four required_evidence types per-type rules in validate_evidence, exactly as G01/G02, so the gate OPENS each artifact. Ship examples/gate-dossier.G03.json (validated in CI) and prove an instance advances G02->G03 on a valid G03 dossier.
business_value: Without per-type rules a G03 dossier passes on names alone. This makes the four UX exit criteria -- happy/unhappy paths, accessibility addressed, support operations defined, design validated -- deterministic gate refusals rather than prose.
in_scope: check_journeys / check_service_blueprint / check_accessibility / check_user_validation in badf_gate.py + registration in EVIDENCE_RULES
examples/gate-dossier.G03.json + its four evidence/artifact pairs; CI validates it
tests/test_badf_g03.py (failing-first) + a G02->G03 pair-acceptance in tests/test_badf_advance.py
mutation; own G07 self-dossier; doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
out_of_scope: a design-authoring skill (a later WP if a real task needs it)
any vendored UX toolkit; any competing validator module
later gates G04+ -- one WP each
acceptance_criteria: journeys with only a happy path (no unhappy path) are refused
a service-blueprint that leaves a journey uncovered, or names an unknown journey, is refused
a lane with no support actions is refused
a not_applicable accessibility criterion without a rationale is refused
a user-validation with zero participants, or an unresolved major finding, is refused
an instance at G02/APPROVED advances to G03/APPROVED on a valid G03 dossier
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Reuses the G01/G02 substrate -- no new validator module. Continues the one-gate-at-a-time march (G01 WP-0030, G02 WP-0041, G03 here).
